65834-the-riders-of-ramapo-pass.title: The Riders Of Ramapo Pass
65834-the-riders-of-ramapo-pass.creator: Dean L. Heffernan
65834-the-riders-of-ramapo-pass.description: A book by Dean L. Heffernan. He calmly looked over his surroundings. Then, with perfect ease, he lifted his heavy wooden box by its rope handle and advanced to the group of men who had been more or less disinterestedly watching him from the low porch of the town’s combined saloon, post-office, and general store.

73269-a-prince-of-lovers.title: A Romance
73269-a-prince-of-lovers.creator: Sir William Magnay Bart
73269-a-prince-of-lovers.description: A book by Sir William Magnay Bart. For the greater part of two centuries after the close of the Thirty Years War there existed in Germany some two hundred independent states. It is with two of these, lying in the midst of what was once the Hercynian forest, which tract even then, although in slow process of clearing, retained much of its primitive, desolate wildness, that the events of the following story are concerned.

arxiv-2111-13352.title: A unified approach to higher order discrete and smooth isoperimetric inequalities
arxiv-2111-13352.creator: Kwok-Kun Kwong
arxiv-2111-13352.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kwok-Kun Kwong. We present a unified approach to derive sharp isoperimetric type inequalities of arbitrary high order. In particular, we obtain (i) sharp high order discrete polygonal isoperimetric type inequalities, (ii) sharp high order isoperimetric type inequalities for smooth curves with both upper and lower bounds for the isoperimetric deficit, and (iii) sharp higher order Chernoff type inequalities involving a generalized width function and higher order locus of curvature centers.

arxiv-2201-03036.title: In-Device Feedback in Immersive Head-Mounted Displays for Distance Perception During Teleoperation of Unmanned Ground Vehicles
arxiv-2201-03036.creator: Yiming Luo, Jialin Wang, Rongkai Shi, Hai-Ning Liang, Shan Luo
arxiv-2201-03036.description: Abstract In recent years, Virtual Reality (VR) Head-Mounted Displays (HMD) have been used to provide an immersive, first-person view in real-time for the remote-control of Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGV). One critical issue is that it is challenging to perceive the distance of obstacles surrounding the vehicle from 2D views in the HMD, which deteriorates the control of UGV.

arxiv-2206-14325.title: On the Role of Defects in the Electronic Structure of MnBi 2-x Sb x Te 4
arxiv-2206-14325.creator: D. Nevola, Kevin F. Garrity, N. Zaki, J.-Q. Yan, H. Miao, Sugata Chowdhury, P. D. Johnson
arxiv-2206-14325.description: Abstract Elemental substitution is a proven method of Fermi level tuning in topological insulators, which is needed for device applications. Through static and time resolved photoemission, we show that in MnBi 2 Te 4 , elemental substitution of Bi with Sb indeed tunes the Fermi level towards the bulk band gap, making the material charge neutral at 35% Sb concentration.

arxiv-2212-08437.title: Kinetically constrained models out of equilibrium
arxiv-2212-08437.creator: Ivailo Hartarsky, Fabio Lucio Toninelli
arxiv-2212-08437.description: Abstract We study the full class of kinetically constrained models in arbitrary dimension and out of equilibrium, in the regime where the density q q of facilitating sites in the equilibrium measure (but not necessarily in the initial measure) is close to 1 1 .

arxiv-2401-06091.title: A Closer Look at AUROC and AUPRC under Class Imbalance
arxiv-2401-06091.creator: Matthew B. McDermott, Haoran Zhang, Lasse Hyldig Hansen, Giovanni Angelotti, Jack Gallifant
arxiv-2401-06091.description: Abstract In machine learning (ML), a widespread claim is that the area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) is a superior metric for model comparison to the area under the receiver operating characteristic (AUROC) for tasks with class imbalance. This paper refutes this notion on two fronts.

arxiv-2504-16120.title: A Data-Centric Approach for Safe and Secure Large Language Models against Threatening and Toxic Content
arxiv-2504-16120.creator: Chaima Njeh, Haïfa Nakouri, Fehmi Jaafar
arxiv-2504-16120.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLM) have made remarkable progress, but concerns about potential biases and harmful content persist. To address these apprehensions, we introduce a practical solution for ensuring LLM’s safe and ethical use. Our novel approach focuses on a post-generation correction mechanism, the BART-Corrective Model, which adjusts generated content to ensure safety and security.

arxiv-2510-27404.title: Pseudo-Hermitian QFT: relativistic scattering and symmetry structure
arxiv-2510-27404.creator: Ruifeng Leng, Cheng-Yang Lee, Siyi Zhou
arxiv-2510-27404.description: Abstract Unitarity is a cornerstone of quantum theory, ensuring the conservation of probability and information. Although non-Hermitian Hamiltonians are typically associated with open or dissipative systems, pseudo-Hermitian quantum mechanics shows that real spectra and unitary evolution can still emerge through a suitably defined inner product.

arxiv-2511-08046.title: ProSona: Prompt-Guided Personalization for Multi-Expert Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2511-08046.creator: Aya Elgebaly 8 Nikolaos Delopoulos 2 Juliane Hörner - Rieber 3,4 Carolin Rippke 4 Sebastian Klüter 4 Luca Boldrini 5 Lorenzo Placidi 5 Riccardo Dal Bello 6 Nicolaus Andratschke 6 Michael Baumgartl 6 Claus Belka 2,7 Christopher Kurz 2 Guillaume Landry 2,7 Shadi Albarqouni 1,9
arxiv-2511-08046.description: Abstract Automated medical image segmentation suffers from high inter-observer variability, particularly in tasks such as lung nodule delineation, where experts often disagree. Existing approaches either collapse this variability into a consensus mask or rely on separate model branches for each annotator.

arxiv-2512-03606.title: Observation-driven correction of numerical weather prediction for marine winds
arxiv-2512-03606.description: Abstract Accurate marine wind forecasts are essential for safe navigation, ship routing, and energy operations, yet they remain challenging because observations over the ocean are sparse, heterogeneous, and temporally variable. We reformulate wind forecasting as observation-informed correction of a global numerical weather prediction (NWP) model.

arxiv-2601-13028.title: Generalized MICZ-Kepler systems on three-dimensional sphere and hyperboloid
arxiv-2601-13028.creator: Levon Mardoyan, Armen Nersessian
arxiv-2601-13028.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Levon Mardoyan, Armen Nersessian. We propose analogs of the generalized MICZ-Kepler system on the three-dimensional sphere and (two-sheet) hyperboloid. We then construct their energy spectra and normalized wave functions, concluding that the suggested systems are minimally superintegrable. I Introduction About five decades ago, Zwanziger Zw and McIntosh and Cisneros MIC independently suggested a maximally superintegrable generalization of the three-dimensional Kepler-Coulomb system, specified by the presence of a Dirac monopole and inheriting the qualitative properties of the Kepler-Coulomb problem.

doe-osti-3029078-systems-biology-to-enab.creator: Unknown
doe-osti-3029078-systems-biology-to-enab.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. This final technical report synthesizes major research results for DOE award DE-SC0022207. The project sought to identify metabolic control points and bottlenecks that regulate flux to free fatty acids (FFAs) in Picosynechococcus sp. PCC 7002 by treating lipid metabolism

plos-pone-0359271.description: Stabilization of cervical stiffness associated with cervical pessary placement in women at risk for preterm birth

pmc-11440761.title: De novo biosynthesis of β-Arbutin in Komagataella phaffii based on metabolic engineering strategies
pmc-11440761.creator: Jiashuo Yang, Liu Yang, Fengguang Zhao, Chunting Ye, Shuangyan Han
pmc-11440761.description: Backgroundβ-Arbutin, found in the leaves of bearberry, stands out as one of the globally acknowledged eco-friendly whitening additives in recent years. However, the natural abundance of β-Arbutin is low, and the cost-effectiveness of using chemical synthesis or plant extraction methods is low, which cannot meet the requirements.

pmc-12571189.title: Inhibition of Histone Deacetylases Induces Cancer Cell Apoptosis Through the PERK Pathway of ER Stress Response
pmc-12571189.creator: Xuan Wang, Caiyun Yang, Yili Yang, Feng Xu, Donglan Yuan, Yuexi Gu
pmc-12571189.description: Activation of the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress is an adaptive response to disturbed ER homeostasis caused by the accumulation of misfolded or unfolded proteins, or an acute increase in the entry of newly synthesised or mutated proteins into the ER lumen.

pmc-12588277.title: Universality in the small scales of turbulent Taylor-Couette flow
pmc-12588277.creator: Julio M. Barros, Christian Butcher, Pinaki Chakraborty
pmc-12588277.description: From a humble kitchen blender to the vast galactic disks, rotating turbulent flows exhibit remarkable diversity. They are also replete with puzzling features. A notable example is the energy spectrum of a widely studied rotating flow—the turbulent Taylor-Couette (TC) flow.

pmc-12659137.title: Cardiac rehabilitation for elderly patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting: a systematic review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12659137.creator: Juan Huang, Changhong Liu, Jiaxiang Xie, Juan Han
pmc-12659137.description: BackgroundCardiac rehabilitation (CR) has been shown to improve outcomes in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG); however, its specific effects on elderly CABG patients remain unclear. This meta-analysis aims to evaluate the benefits of CR for elderly patients undergoing CABG.

pmc-13207650.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Characterization of the SMXL Gene Family in Lavandula angustifolia
pmc-13207650.creator: Yongguang Li, Kaihang Zhang, Xiaoru Zhang, Hongxuan Li, Hanyi Li, Bingbing Liu, Xiaoxing Wang, Chunqiao Wang, Yang Yang, Jiandong Ren, Cuijie Cui, Nuerkaimaier Mulati, Shangfu Ren, Bin Ma, Jishan Xiang
pmc-13207650.description: SMXL proteins serve as central regulators of strigolactone (SL) and karrikin (KAR) signaling pathways, orchestrating key developmental processes including shoot branching, floral transition, photomorphogenesis and stress responses. However, the SMXL gene family has not been systematically characterized in Lavandula angustifolia. We identified 37 LaSMXL genes in the lavender genome.

pmc-13284527.title: Bringing the Hospital to the Adult Patient: A Qualitative Study of Patients' and Relatives' Experiences of Mobile Emergency Care at Home
pmc-13284527.creator: Åsa Falchenberg, Ulf Andersson, Anders Sterner, Gabriella Norberg Boysen, Henrik Andersson
pmc-13284527.description: AimTo explore how patients and their relatives perceive and experience emergency care delivered at home by Mobile Emergency Teams (METs).DesignAn exploratory qualitative design was used to explore how patients and relatives experienced the care encounter. This approach was appropriate given the exploratory nature of the study.

pmc-13305512.title: Correlation Is Not Prediction: Reassessing Predictive MRI Evidence in Guidelines for Persons With Relapsing-Remitting Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-13305512.creator: Dulat Minas, Stefan Buchka, Joachim Havla, Ulrich Mansmann
pmc-13305512.description: BackgroundEffective treatment monitoring and treatment decisions in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) require accurate and individualized prediction of future disease courses. Guidelines from the Magnetic Resonance Imaging in Multiple Sclerosis (MAGNIMS) group and the Canadian Multiple Sclerosis Working Group (CMSWG) frequently cite MRI outcomes as predictive, but the methodological quality of this evidence is uncertain.

pmc-13357753.title: Dynamic maps of plastic-mulched farmlands in Northeast China from 1985 to 2025
pmc-13357753.creator: Bowen Niu, Xinmin Zhang, Yifang Zhang, Xiaolu Yan, Dehai Zhu, Quanlong Feng
pmc-13357753.description: We provide PMF-NEChina-40D, the first plastic-mulched farmlands (PMFs) dynamic monitoring dataset in Northeast (NE) China for the past four decades from 1985 to 2025. Multi-sensor Landsat series and Sentinel-2 imagery were processed on the Google Earth Engine platform, and a dual-temporal PMFs mapping framework integrating film-on and film-off stages was proposed.

pmc-13380227.title: Design and development of an open-source high-temperature FFF 3D printer for high-performance polymers
pmc-13380227.creator: Charlotte Thompson, Luke Salisbury, Evan Garrison, Lillian DeJean, Santanu Kundu, Matthew W Priddy
pmc-13380227.description: Various commercial systems have been developed for printing high-performance polymers such as polyetherimide (PEI) and polyetheretherketone (PEEK) for use in medical, aerospace, automotive, and electrical components.High-performance polymers offer improved chemical resistance, thermal resistance, and mechanical properties compared to commonly used FFF materials such as PLA, PETG, and ABS.

pmc-13481597.title: Risk of periprosthetic joint infection within 1 year following robotic-assisted versus conventional primary total knee arthroplasty: a propensity-score-matched cohort study
pmc-13481597.creator: Shuaifei Tian, Yicheng Li, Wenbo Mu, Baochao Ji, Xiaogang Zhang, Li Cao, Jin Zhao
pmc-13481597.description: BackgroundRobotic-assisted total knee arthroplasty (RA-TKA) is increasingly being adopted for its ability to enhance bone-resection accuracy and component alignment. However, whether these technical gains influence the risk of periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) remains uncertain, especially in the context of prolonged operative duration.

pmc-13551919.title: A complex case of piperacillin-tazobactam resistant Elizabethkingia anophelis neonatal meningitis: the challenge of treatment and literature review
pmc-13551919.creator: Yixiang Wu, Sitian Ke, Lizhong Du, Zhongyue Li

pmc-13631246.title: Antimicrobial resistance among clinical isolates associated with combat-related infections in Ukraine: first nationwide surveillance, 2023-2024
pmc-13631246.creator: Ludmila Kasatkina, Ihnat Havrylov, Anzhela Sboieva, Valentyna Yanovska, Tetiana Glushkevych, Artem Horbachevskyi
pmc-13631246.description: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a critical global health threat, which reduces the effectiveness of treatment and drives higher morbidity, mortality, and costs. In Ukraine, the problem has been further aggravated by Russia’s full-scale invasion, with favorable conditions for the spread of resistant pathogens.
